title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - WearableDevice
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/WearableDevice. A device that is intended to be located near, on or in an organism (its Wearer). Abstract parent of InBodyWearable, OnBodyWearable, NearBodyWearable, TextileBasedWearable and FabricWearable. Subclass of geo:Feature and saref:Device per the SAREF4WEAR ontology (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.3). The ontology's WearableProperty/ElectricalProperty/ElectricalSafetyProperty/EmissionProperty grouping classes, plus EnvironmentalProperty/CrowdProperty (measured by a wearable's environmental/crowd sensors per TS 103 410-9 Figures 6 and 9), are not modelled as separate top-level entities: per explicit translation instruction, each of their named-individual measurement kinds (BatteryRemainingTime, AcousticEmission, HeatEmission, RadioFrequencyEmission, AirQuality, SoundLevel, Temperature, CrowdSize, QueueSize) becomes a directly-named open-vocabulary attribute on this entity instead -- see standard-metadata.yaml for the full rationale. ElectricalSafetyProperty defines no named individual in SAREF4WEAR v2.1.1 and therefore yields no attribute here. hasSensor, measuresFeature and controlsFeature are declared in TS 103 410-9 Table 2 but not yet present in the published saref4wear.ttl v2.1.1 serialization; they are included here under the same s4wear namespace per the normative text.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'WearableDevice'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: GeoProperty. Model:'https://purl.org/geojson/vocab#Point'. Current geolocation of the wearable device (it is a subclass of geo:Feature).

hasInterface.description: Relationship. Interface(s) with which this device transmits/receives data. Links to one or more Interface entities.

hasPowerSupply.description: Relationship. Power supply equipping this device. Links to one or more PowerSupply entities.

hasSensor.description: Relationship. Textile-based sensor(s) used by this device to acquire information from the wearer or the surrounding environment. Links to one or more TextileBasedSensor entities. (Declared in TS 103 410-9 Table 2; not yet in the published ttl.)

consistsOf.description: Relationship. Memory storage component(s) installed within this device. Links to one or more MemoryStorage entities.

followsPolicy.description: Relationship. Policy/policies followed by this wearable device. Links to one or more Policy entities.

hasFunction.description: Relationship. Function(s) this device is capable of. Links to one or more CommunicatingFunction, ControllingFunction, NavigatingFunction or NotifyingFunction entities.

isLocated.description: Relationship. General geographical association between this wearable device and its Wearer. Links to a Wearer entity. (More specific subclasses use isLocatedIn/isLocatedOn/isLocatedNear.)

sendsInformationTo.description: Relationship. Other wearable device(s) this device sends information to. Links to one or more WearableDevice entities.

sendsNotificationsTo.description: Relationship. Wearer(s) this device sends notifications to. Links to one or more Wearer entities.

monitors.description: Relationship. Other device(s) this device monitors. Links to one or more WearableDevice entities.

measuresFeature.description: Relationship. Feature(s) of interest measured by this device, independently of any inferable measurement relationship. Links to one or more Wearer, User, LivingOrganism or Software entities. (Declared in TS 103 410-9 Table 2 narrative; not yet in the published ttl.)

controlsFeature.description: Relationship. Feature(s) of interest controlled by this device. Links to one or more Wearer, User, LivingOrganism or Software entities. (Declared in TS 103 410-9 Table 2 narrative; not yet in the published ttl.)

height.description: Property. Height dimension of the wearable device, in centimetres (s4wear:hasHeight).

length.description: Property. Length dimension of the wearable device, in centimetres (s4wear:hasLength).

width.description: Property. Width dimension of the wearable device, in centimetres (s4wear:hasWidth).

weight.description: Property. Weight of the wearable device, in grams (s4wear:hasWeight).

operatingTemperature.description: Property. Optimal operating temperature of the wearable device, in degrees Celsius (s4wear:hasOperatingTemperature).

dataTransmissionRate.description: Property. Data transmission rate of the wearable device, in Mbps (s4wear:hasDataTransmissionRate).

storage.description: Property. Memory storage capacity of the wearable device, in MB (s4wear:hasStorage).

batteryRemainingTime.description: Property. Time until the device's battery is discharged, in minutes. Open-vocabulary value standing in for the s4wear:BatteryRemainingTime (ElectricalProperty) named individual.

acousticEmission.description: Property. Acoustic emission of the wearable, in dB. Open-vocabulary value standing in for the s4wear:AcousticEmission (EmissionProperty) named individual.

heatEmission.description: Property. Heat emission of the wearable, in degrees Celsius. Open-vocabulary value standing in for the s4wear:HeatEmission (EmissionProperty) named individual.

radioFrequencyEmission.description: Property. Radio frequency emission of the wearable, in dBm. Open-vocabulary value standing in for the s4wear:RadioFrequencyEmission (EmissionProperty) named individual.

airQuality.description: Property. Air quality index measured by the wearable's environmental sensor. Open-vocabulary value standing in for the s4wear:AirQuality (EnvironmentalProperty) named individual.

soundLevel.description: Property. Ambient sound level measured by the wearable, in dB. Open-vocabulary value standing in for the s4wear:SoundLevel (EnvironmentalProperty) named individual.

temperature.description: Property. Ambient temperature measured by the wearable, in degrees Celsius. Open-vocabulary value standing in for the s4wear:Temperature (EnvironmentalProperty) named individual.

crowdSize.description: Property. Size of a crowd detected by the wearable (e.g. a crowd-control device). Open-vocabulary value standing in for the s4wear:CrowdSize (CrowdProperty) named individual.

queueSize.description: Property. Size of a queue detected by the wearable. Open-vocabulary value standing in for the s4wear:QueueSize (CrowdProperty) named individual.
